user_goal.text: Delete the newest note in Markor.

benchmark_success.text: Native benchmark success requires the runner to record `done=true` and `MarkorDeleteNewestNote.is_successful(env)` to return `1.0`; for this task, that evaluator returns `1.0` only when the post-run Markor file list sorted by `change_time` matches the stored pre-run sorted list on every remaining `file_name` and `change_time`, with the post-run list length exactly one less.

checked_by.text: Runner completion gating plus the `MarkorDeleteNewestNote` before/after Markor file-metadata comparison.

decisive_artifacts.question: Does retained run evidence show whether the episode finished with `done=true` or `done=false`?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained Markor file metadata snapshots or listings from before and after the run
decisive_artifacts.question: When the pre-run and post-run Markor files are sorted by `change_time`, do all remaining entries match by `file_name` and `change_time` at the same indices, and is the post-run file count exactly one less?

success_if.text: Retained run evidence shows the episode ended with `done=true`.

Retained before/after Markor file metadata shows the evaluator's acceptance rule holds: after sorting by `change_time`, every remaining post-run entry matches the stored pre-run entry at the same index on `file_name` and `change_time`, and the post-run list has exactly one fewer file.

fail_if.text: Retained run evidence shows `done=false`, which the runner converts to native failure regardless of the task evaluator result.

Retained before/after Markor file metadata shows the evaluator comparison fails: any remaining sorted entry differs from the stored pre-run entry on `file_name` or `change_time`, or the post-run list length is not exactly one less than pre-run.

undecided_if.text: Usable retained evidence for the completion gate or the required pre-run/post-run Markor file metadata comparison is missing or unusable, and the retained evidence does not already establish failure under the runner gate or evaluator comparison.
